What was the total value of insiders' open-market stock purchases in 2023?
SELECT sum(try_cast(trans_shares AS double) * try_cast(trans_pricepershare AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans WHERE trans_code = 'P' AND trans_date LIKE '%-2023'
What was California's unemployment rate in April 2020?
SELECT year, period, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data WHERE series_id = 'LASST060000000000003' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' AND period = 'M04'
How much did Pfizer pay doctors and teaching hospitals in 2020?

SELECT sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE submitting_applicable_manufacturer_or_applicable_gpo_name LIKE 'Pfizer%' AND cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2020'
What share of active community water systems are privately owned?

SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN owner_type_code = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems WHERE pws_activity_code = 'A' AND pws_type_code = 'CWS'
How many reactors reported running at full power on New Year's Day 2020?
SELECT count(*) AS reactors FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_power_status WHERE reportdt LIKE '1/1/2020 %' AND try_cast(power AS double) = 100
What share of transmission line segments run underground?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN type LIKE '%UNDERGROUND%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_power_transmission_lines
Which countries publish the most patents that name chemical compounds?
SELECT country, count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the peak hourly load on Long Island in July 2019?
SELECT max(try_cast(integrated_load AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_zonal_load_hourly_palintegrated WHERE name = 'LONGIL' AND time_stamp LIKE '07/%/2019%'
Which day of the week was deadliest on American roads in 2022?
SELECT day_weekname, sum(try_cast(fatals AS integer)) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many device reports in 2023 described a death?
SELECT count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_health.fda_device_event WHERE event_type = 'Death' AND date_received LIKE '2023%'
Which federal assistance programs paid out the most in fiscal year 2023?

SELECT cfda_title, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_assistance WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubChem bioassays were deposited by ChEMBL?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_bioassay_aid2depositorname WHERE depositorname = 'ChEMBL'
Which Texas cities have the most hazardous waste sites on EPA's list?
SELECT city_name, count(*) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_facilities WHERE state_code = 'TX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many small molecules does GDB-11 enumerate?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.gdb_gdb11
Which industries win the most sub-contract dollars?

SELECT naics_description, sum(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE subaward_type = 'sub-contract' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many hospitals filed Medicare cost reports for fiscal year 2024?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS reports FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_nmrc WHERE hcris_fy = '2024'
How many awards were funded with COVID-19 relief money?
SELECT sum(try_cast(award_count AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_covid_faba_spending WHERE spending_level = 'subtier_agency'
Which Pennsylvania counties gave the most votes to the Republican presidential candidate in 2020?

SELECT county_name, sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'PENNSYLVANIA' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND party_simplified = 'REPUBLICAN' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many voting-age citizens live in the Bronx?
SELECT try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_county WHERE geoname = 'Bronx County, New York' AND lntitle = 'Total'
Which industries received the most Homeland Security contract money in fiscal year 2021?

SELECT naics_description, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2021' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many pension plans reported a funding deficiency on Schedule R?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_sch_r WHERE try_cast(pen_funding_deficiency_amt AS double) > 0
Does the library hold more CRS reports or GAO reports?
SELECT source, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
